title: NPC Inventory and Equipment Reset Identity Policy
rules: NPC item reconciliation requires an authoritative NPC identity, reset key, canonical item, and target quantity.
Inventory and explicitly slotted equipment are reconciled separately.
Existing matching instances retain identity and only deficits are created.
Equipment items require a legal generated equipment relationship and target at most one item per slot.
Existing quantities above target are never silently removed.
NPC Runtime or World Runtime owns spawn and reset scheduling.

bidirectional_relationships.npc_to_items: NPC identity -> reset key -> canonical inventory/equipment target
bidirectional_relationships.item_to_npc: runtime item instance -> NPC owner/location -> reset provenance
